mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over 3 months signals robust consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a single month signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL growth < 1% over 6 months) signals a stable monetary policy, reducing uncertainty and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% over a quarter signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
